[[File:Trade_Federation_Hulk.jpg|thumb|300px|The Trade Federation Hulk in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].]]

The '''Trade Federation Hulk''' was a heap of debris of a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] ship in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].

This hulk standed as a reminder of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] ancient [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle]] against the forces of greed and a monument to the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Force's]] prowess in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] combat. Even still, rare members of the Trade Federation still lived at the site and were often left alone.

A Trade Federation Outpost was also located in this region.
